name: ossify
description: Experimental OpenCode opt-in for a skeleton-first lifecycle from Release 0 through MVP and v1. The v0.x engine, six entry skills, and close ceremonies are packaged through the root bundle's explicit allowlist; /ossify:run-spine drives a planned spine's rounds end to end, /ossify:doctor diagnoses a project's state, spec, rules, interop and budgets, and the standalone utilities work in any repository: /ossify:handoff + /ossify:handoff-resume compose and re-verify generic session handoffs, and /ossify:work-pr drives a pull request through the review-fix-merge loop to an operator-acked merge. Ossify remains outside stable Claude and Codex marketplaces until Plan D's consolidated eval and pilot gate.
